summary: Complete migration from localStorage mock to production-ready paginated REST API for admin user management. Three-layer architecture (types, service, UI) integrates cleanly. Dashboard stats derive from API meta.total via parallel queries. Users page implements server-side pagination, 300ms debounced search, filter tabs, and full CRUD with proper async handling. All acceptance criteria met, TypeScript compilation passes, no blocking issues.
